patch_description: The current version runs only a single greedy pass with a fixed sample rate. The prior best version used 60 random restarts, which scored 355 vs current 352 — showing variance across runs. My improvement: restore multi-start randomized greedy (with increasing sample rate as the sequence grows, since decisions near the end matter less for sampling overhead but correctness matters) and add a cheap 2-opt style local search: repeatedly try swapping adjacent transactions or moving a transaction to a different position, and accept improvements. This hill-climbing on top of greedy typically reduces makespan further since pure greedy gets stuck in local orderings that adjacent swaps can fix. I keep total work bounded by a restart budget so runtime stays reasonable.
